prog = '''"""task-295c7e3f: lattice lines with marked crossings -> block map of marked regions.

Rule (verified on all 4 demo pairs and the test input):
- fill = most common color in the grid.
- separator rows/cols = full lines containing no fill cells.
- line color = most common color among all cells on separator lines.
- marked crossings = separator-line intersection cells whose value != line color.
- Output = block map over the bounding box of marked crossings, with row/col
  bands defined by ALL separator lines inside that box; each cell is the marker
  (crossing) color if all four of its corner crossings are marked (equal and
  != line color), else the fill color.
"""
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid); w = len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    fill = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for c in range(w))]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))]
    cross = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in sep_rows for c in sep_cols}
    line_cells = ([grid[r][c] for r in sep_rows for c in range(w)] +
                  [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in sep_cols])
    line = Counter(line_cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = {k for k, v in cross.items() if v != line}
    if not marked:
        return [[fill]]
    rs = sorted({r for r, c in marked}); cs = sorted({c for r, c in marked})
    brows = [r for r in sep_rows if rs[0] <= r <= rs[-1]]
    bcols = [c for c in sep_cols if cs[0] <= c <= cs[-1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(brows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(bcols) - 1):
            vals = [cross[(brows[i], bcols[j])], cross[(brows[i], bcols[j + 1])],
                    cross[(brows[i + 1], bcols[j])], cross[(brows[i + 1], bcols[j + 1])]]
            row.append(vals[0] if all(x == vals[0] and x != line for x in vals) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
open(base+'/programs/task-295c7e3f.py','w').write(prog)
